steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Cazzo! I said, on my order, you idiot!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: I-It wasn't me! I only just pulled the safety on my gun—

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: And it's not them, either. See that shocked look on their faces, they're checking themselves for holes...

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Did someone's weapon go off?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: No, nobody's hurt... but where did that gunshot come from?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: I thought I knew what to do just now, but... w-what do we do now?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I can see the head of the first float already...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ...Hey, you over there.
*Cough*—Gah—
Two hundred meters... just two hundred...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Haven't lost your touch, Ingrid... not one bit...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Merda, it hurts... I can feel my blood flow out of me... but that means I still have time...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Get out of this alley, get back to the square, and I can still bring things under control...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: We have the courthouse and the port...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Maybe I'll die, but... *cough*... before I die, I'll sit in the judge's chair, and deliver the final judgment of... *cough*... this ridiculous testing ground...
Antonio leans against the wall and does his best to stay upright, wobbling towards the exit.
The alley is dark, and every step takes massive effort.
For some reason, he thinks back to how the guerillas crept through the jungle of Bolívar by night, escaping from the Singas government.
Antonio thinks back to the circles that the noble drunkenly drew on the list, and his severed head when the guerillas cut it off.
He thinks back to Ingrid, Venezia Senior, Leontuzzo, Alberto, Signora Sicilia... all the people he hates.
He will take everything from them. He will draw a big, bloody cross on their names.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It's not over yet—
He stops.
He feels the cold metal of gun muzzle pressed to his forehead.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: A-Antonio.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Carle?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I ordered you to get out—

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: W-Who do you think you are to kick me out?!

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: You're just the Don's guard tuskbeast, Antonio!

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: No matter how hard you try to disguise your ears and tail, you—

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You want to kill me?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: YOU?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Your hands are shaking!

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You don't know who my enemies are! You don't know what I'm building! You stupid, worthless coglione—
Carle stares blankly at the lifeless body on the ground. He has never seen such fury as that which is on Antonio's face, even unto death.
It almost seems like it was not the bullet that took Antonio's life, but the fact that it was he, Carle, who fired the bullet.
Antonio's blood seeps through the cracks on the ground, in the shape of a massive, bloody cross.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Hey, you over there.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Eirene?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It's okay.
Before everybody's eyes, Eirene leaves the drivers' line and takes two steps forward, standing in the middle of the road.
Facing off the tense crowd of mafiosi, she takes a deep breath, and lowers her crossbow.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What is the meaning of this?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Look. The first float has rounded the corner...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: The parade is here. Are we really going to fight to the death in front of hundreds of thousands of Nuova Volsinii citizens?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Whatever your plan was, it's too late, isn't it?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You want us to lower the weapons?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You think we're stupid?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: We're doing the same thing.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: The White Wolf scattered this stuff on the plaza. We, as conscientious citizens of Nuova Volsinii, volunteered to clean up the square so that the parade can pass through.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: That's what happened, no more, no less. All of you Signori and Signore are witnesses for me and all the drivers behind me.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: They, in turn, are your witnesses.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It's Carnevale, after all. Let's give the parade a warm, proper welcome.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: *Pant*—*pant*—
Get in, Carle.
The parade is almost here. We can't park here for long.
There's a Carnevale mask on the driver's seat. Put it on and hide that blood on your face.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: D-Don Venezia.

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: Move.
The car starts moving, and the parade crowd passes through behind.
Music and cheering mingle under the bright lights. It has been a good four or five hours since the revelry started, but Nuova Volsinii's excitement shows no sign of abating.
From the expansion plate, through all of Nuova Volsinii's major districts, the procession is about to arrive at its destination. Nobody notices a lone car driving in the opposite direction.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: I'm sorry, D-Don Venezia, I didn't get the job done.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: You gave me a chance after Antonio ran me out, ordered me to take him out quietly, but I...

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: If Ingrid didn't already mortally wound him before I got there...

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: No, Antonio died by your hand.

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: The Don's permission is required for the execution of a formal associate of the familglia. At minimum, a proper explanation should be given to important members of the famiglia.

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: Ingrid's methods were not... decent.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: Understood, sir.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: But now, Antonio is dead... he was your son-in-law, the famiglia's—

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii has its rules. So does Venezia.

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: What Anton did was wrong. This is an act of kindness. He is with Bella now.

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: Besides, his death will not be meaningless.

steps.name: Nervous Mafioso
steps.text: What next, sir?

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: We go home and clean the house.

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: The first thing that City Hall and the courts will see when they get up in the morning tomorrow is Venezia's good faith. We will sit down together, and we will talk like decent people.

steps.name: Venezia Sr.
steps.text: It will be a busy night.

steps.name: Carnevale Participant A
steps.text: Keep up, keep up! Court Square is just ahead! We got to get ahead of that float to get a good place—

steps.name: Carnevale Participant B
steps.text: Well, don't squeeze!

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: You're not joining them, Signorina?

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: Your plain outfit stands out in a crowd of colorful costumes and masks! What an idea, to turn things on its head.

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: May I take a few photos? I can mail them to you if you give me an address.

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: Hey, are you listening?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Agnese?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Why don't you say anything, Agnese?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You've never left me before... where are you?
The Lupo girl's eyes harden.
The photographer gazes across the street. The red hood stands out in the crowd, even in this revelry.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: A trap? How did you—

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: You got distracted.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Is Agnese your grandma? You can't find your grandma too?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: You're the last one. The last true wolf.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Kill you, and I will know the answer.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: I'm here, child.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I won, grandma.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: I saw it.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: I saw how the entire battle played out. How you zeroed in onto the Fang of Agnese, lured her into a trap, and struck her down with a single blow.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: You can see? Have your eyes healed, Grandma?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Have your arms grown back? Is your heart whole again? Why... why can't I see you? Why can't I get close to you?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: My sweet child, would you have hunted with such fervor if I didn't say that?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Red killed the true wolf and earned an insipid victory for grandma. Finally.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Now I go off to find another sweet child.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: You lied to me?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Why? I don't understand.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Oh, bother.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Alright, let me put it another way. Maybe then you'll know what to do.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: You're like the ones you killed, my child.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: You're both huntress and true wolf.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Not all the true wolves have been slain. Grandma hasn't been saved yet.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: (Claps)

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Look at the coordination of the two groups! Truly impressive, isn't it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: In the space of a few minutes, they've hidden all the weapons in the trucks, and stand side-by-side to welcome the parade procession. It's almost like they rehearsed it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Who would believe me if I said they were pointing weapons at each other just a few minutes ago?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You win again, Texas!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Once again, justice and conscience have taken your side!
Texas does not answer. The White Wolf claps even harder, an ink-black mask on her face.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Actually, I'm more curious why you suddenly put that mask on.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's Carnevale, after all!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why the long face, Texas? You won. You should be more cheerful than that.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Look! The parade enters Court Square. That little intermezzo just now never turns into a full-scale riot. Peace and love for all.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or is it because you just can't help thinking that the only reason it turned out this way was because of a single gunshot out of nowhere, which gave one of the wolves the chance to cool its head?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And Carnevale is nothing but a red carpet laid out on a swamp?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What are you trying to say, Lappland?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What happened tonight is not the same as the civil disorder that happened in the other cities of Siracusa.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...The only difference being the involvement of a bunch of ordinary people, who were pushed to desperation by the mafia's turf wars.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well... you're not wrong.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But they really did put on a remarkable show.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Especially that driver lady that we saw in court, who seems to have understood a lot of things without having to be taught...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii is not a vineyard where you just sow the seeds and wait for the fruits to grow.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Don't forget that it sits right in the middle of this swamp by the name of Siracusa.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The famiglie have never been the only ones who had to crawl through mud and water. Don't underestimate the power of this bog, Texas. It turns everyone into hungry, ravenous wolves.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It has ingrained into the genes of the Siracusans the instinct to turn any new turf into the same swamp.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: This endless cycle is what Siracusa is.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Don't try to escape it or change it. The easiest thing to do is to learn to enjoy the swim.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: This is what the old man, Signora Sicilia, and you... what all of you have taught me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Leontuzzo and Lavinia have taken radical measures in order to validate an order that exists outside the mafia... there is a long way to go.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But this is why Nuova Volsinii exists. It offers a new possibility.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But really, did you do all this in order to give this speech?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I didn't know you were so concerned about the future of Siracusa.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Took the words right out of my mouth, didn't you? I was going to ask you that.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Otherwise, why would you have come here all the way from Lungmen the moment you got my invitation?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I know, you're gonna say—
The White Wolf pauses, clears her throat, and imitates Texas' way of speaking.
Calm and even, yet emotion-filled.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Ahem. 'All those lofty ideals are none of my business. I just work for a logistics company.'

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: 'I'm just here because I care about my friend, and because my conscience wouldn't let me turn a blind eye to certain things... just like in Volsinii...'

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No, Texas, I haven't forgotten the time that we first met...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You had just came to Siracusa. You were standing at the edge of the mobile platform, holding your Nonno Salvatore's hand, watching my family's workers trim the grapevines.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Your nonno and my father were talking about how Columbia was turning into a dump, about Siracusa's good weather, the new year's harvest, and how you'll be staying a while at our place.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Your eyes were BRIGHT back then, and your expressions were much more interesting than they are now—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's because the grapes you picked were so sour they almost burned a hole in my tongue.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Everyone on the square is wearing a mask tonight, but none could compare to the one you wear.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Nobody sees things clearer than you. You were the first one to realize that this is a swamp that you needed to get out of.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But it was your disappointment that made you see, Texas. You once had such high hopes for this swamp.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Forget about my speech. You, Texas, are a true blue idealist!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't deny it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Or rather, whether I am or am not makes no difference.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It doesn't change what I have to do at the end of the day.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: A very Texas answer. Almost boringly so.

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: Is that a LANDSHIP?!

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: Wow, City Hall brought a landship to the show and turned it into a stage?

steps.name: Excited Passerby
steps.text: Wait, look who's on deck...

steps.name: Excited Passerby
steps.text: Is that the Last Texas?

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: I'm sure, I've seen her in the courts of Volsinii—and the one opposite her...

steps.name: Excited Passerby
steps.text: Lappland? The White Wolf who was disowned by the Don of Saluzzo eight years ago?

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: Why are they here at the Carnevale?

steps.name: Excited Passerby
steps.text: Must be City Hall's special guests! Think about it, representatives of two major famiglie here at the climax of Carnevale...

steps.name: Excited Passerby
steps.text: It sends an even more powerful message than Signor Bellone's promotional video!

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: Damn right!
Lappland takes off her mask and gives it to Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You won the bet, didn't you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: In the old days, the famiglie murdered each other on Carnevale, the last surviving wolf taking the masks of the vanquished.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I suppose we need to give the old customs new meaning in this new city... a new life, that kind of stuff, I guess.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: As for the question just now, it doesn't matter what your answer is.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Siracusa makes all of us wear masks, after all.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We're part of Carnevale's main event, Texas.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Regardless of why you're here, here and now, you represent part of Siracusa, whether it's the part that's new, or the part that's broken and needs to be thrown out.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Mafiosi and truck driver, city officials and judges, and all the Siracusans on the square, will see in us the meaning that they want to see.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You may, of course, choose to turn around and leave.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Come on, Texas, don't just stand there. All of Nuova Volsinii is watching!
Silence.
Texas gazes at her old friend, and old enemy, for a long time... and finally extends her hand.
A dozen beast floats drive into Court Square, as though it had been previously rehearsed, and the reveling crowd continues to gush in like the tide.
The sound of music and the cheers of the crowd keeps growing louder. The bright lights and fireworks in the sky provide the perfect backdrop for the duo on stage.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do you hear that? They would not let the good night go gently.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: They're cheering for you and me, for this new city, for a new life.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're still really good at making me feel sick.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But I don't mind being part of the event. I don't mind these people seeing some sort of 'meaning' in me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Without hope, there would never be disappointment. Whether in Columbia or Siracusa, I do, in fact, hope to see a truly vibrant city emerge from the swamp.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If the challenge and complexity of building it are beyond what I can imagine, then I will face the challenge with my friends, not run away from it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Alright, I've made up my mind. I'll take care of one more trouble for you and Siracusa!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm bringing those stupid wolves back to the wilderness, so that Siracusa won't be affected by their dumb game.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No need to thank me. But when the obstacles have all been pushed out of the way, how will they—you—change this swamp?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There's something I suddenly wanted to ask you, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Are you disappointed that I didn't come to Nuova Volsinii for you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Another very Texas answer.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Break a leg, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Mm-hm.
Texas takes the mask.
The White Wolf lets go, without warning, without hesitation. She turns around and walks into the landship's hold.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh, and Texas?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You were fun while it lasted.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Landship, the White Wolf of Saluzzo and Texas, and the Truckers' Union...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What else did we miss?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: S-Signor Bellone...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Hello, Eirene. Haven't seen you in a while.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Perhaps we should have a little chat once the festivities are over.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Go on, Mayor Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The duo's performance has come to an end. Time to deliver the closing speech for Carnevale.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Thanks for bringing me here, Demetri. And sorry I couldn't give you a satisfactory answer even at the very end.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Since when have you been the type to say useless crap like that?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: ...I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Good evening, folks. I'm Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: As you can see, I was a little dinged up, but I'm out of the woods now.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I was actually there in the middle of the parade on the way to Court Square, experiencing this city that we live in together.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm sure little needs to be said about the impressive performance of Signorine Lappland and Texas.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But I wanted to see your faces, say a few things, and spend the night together with you guys.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Many things have changed in Nuova Volsinii over the past year, not least the completion of the Nuova Volsinii Port, the biggest cargo port in Siracusa.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Every connection it makes is like a pulse of the city, demonstrating healthy, robust vitality, supporting thousands of enterprises and hundreds of thousands of livelihoods.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We founded the country's first police academy, a new code of laws, and people are increasingly identifying with Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: This makes me glad and anxious in equal measure.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The city continues to face many problems that cannot be ignored. For example, the citizen credit system remains inconvenient, and there are many cases where it doesn't achieve its intentions.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We also understand that the uniqueness of New Urban Management Act makes it difficult for our citizens to receive the support they need for cases that span jurisdictions.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: A year is a very short period of time. City Hall and the courts still have much to do.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What I want to ask is this: What is Nuova Volsinii to you?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's also the question that I want to ask other Siracusans in Volsinii, Sicilia, Montelupe... what is Nuova Volsinii to them?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: And what is this young city to neighboring Leithanien, distant Ursus, and all the other countries in Terra, for which change is a constant?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Are we a new possibility to them? Not just a different kind of violence, but something stronger, firmer, more close-knit, something worth talking to?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Will they understand that our strength comes from our most earnest desires, that we, and all the others gathered here today, can safeguard our hard-earned new lives?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's what we have been trying to achieve over the past year.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: There is no famiglia in Nuova Volsinii. The reforms associated with this saying doesn't rely on 'Siracusan' methods, as Siracusans know it—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: A secret negotiation, an assasination in the dark, a purge of the city, a deadly struggle between famiglie...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: All that has happened here, and all that will happen, will be viewed through the lens of the law.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We're giving a new order to our new life. The swamp that Siracusans used to take for granted will no longer faze us.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: A friend once said to me that I'm walking down a thorny path.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: He's right. But all the challenges that we have faced is exactly why Nuova Volsinii must continue to move forward.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: For everyone who has been hurt on this path, for everyone who may be hurt in the future, I'm sorry.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But at the same time, I continue to extend an invitation to all the friends who have something to ask of Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We shall trample the thorns together and make this brand-new, one-of-a-kind city better, little by little, until it's ready to usher in a new era.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: As a matter of fact, a new era for Siracusa has already begun, a future filled with infinite possibilities.
Demetri gazes forward silently, at the silhouette of Leontuzzo outlined by the countless lights.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What can I say, Leon?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Saluzzo's wine isn't bad, but I prefer my own.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Bellone will find its way into this city, in my way, by your rules.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I promise that to you.
Demetri turns around.
The mayor's speech continues, but he has received the answer he was looking for. Demetri has accepted the invitation, or perhaps, the declaration of a very long war.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Enjoy the rest of the night!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: And, the dawn of a new day.
